narrative_summary: Strategy 'Maize → Crimson Clover / Hairy Vetch → Fallow': Requires 0 mm/yr net seasonal irrigation [FAO-56]. Helps sustain positive regional groundwater storage (NASA GRACE-FO trend: +2.5 cm/yr). RothC forecasts a 10-year soil organic carbon change of -0.1 t C/ha, elevating soil health to 56/100. Under KALRO / KNBS reference budgets, median expected return is KSh65,645/ha with a worst-10% drought buffer (CVaR-10) of KSh31,247/ha.
validation_message: Calibrated regional model for East African Highlands (Nakuru / Rift Valley Bimodal Belt) (enterprise budgets: kenya; climate biome: Cfb).
